- `website/docs/integrations/providers.md:1224` documents the requested vLLM/Qwen workaround using `extra_body.chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking: false`, alongside disabling `--reasoning-parser qwen3`.
- The documentation landed in `242962e1f5a0d2a29db7683c01de907369eb2145` (from cross-referenced PR #47850, salvaged through #49944) and is included in release `v2026.7.1`.
